resources.string: New messages in your rooms and direct chats, and the test notification
Messages that mention you or reply to you
New message: open the app to read it
Your reply was not sent: tap to open the room
A call came that this phone could not read: open the app to see your calls

The app was stopped (force-stopped, or by the phone), so messages and calls may not have reached this phone until you opened it again. If any seem missing, see Notifications on this device in the account menu.
Allow notifications so messages, mentions and calls reach you when the app is closed or the phone is locked.
Allow the microphone so you can answer a call on a locked phone: there the app cannot ask for it when you answer.

Allow notifications so messages, mentions and calls reach you when the app is closed or the phone is locked, and the microphone so you can answer a call on a locked phone: there the app cannot ask for it when you answer.
Allow full-screen notifications so an incoming call shows over the lock screen and rings like a phone call.

Allow location so the app can send where you are to the people you chose, until the time you chose. While it does, a notification says so, with Stop, also when the app is in the background. Choose Precise for an exact share.

Allow location so the app can send about where you are (to within about 1 km) to the people you chose, until the time you chose. While it does, a notification says so, with Stop, also when the app is in the background.
Allow contacts so the app can find people as you type a number and show their names on texts and calls. They are read on this phone only and never sent to the server.
Shown while the app sends your location for a share you started
Share your location from this phone?
Send your location from this phone to %1$s until %2$s? It goes on while the app is in the background, with a notification and Stop.
Send about where you are (to within about 1 km) from this phone to %1$s until %2$s? It goes on while the app is in the background, with a notification and Stop.
People were added to a location share since you said Send, so this phone stopped sending it. Open the app to confirm who sees it now.
Your server was not told the share stopped
This phone no longer sends your location, but your server could not be told; the share shows your last position until %1$s.
Your location is no longer sent. The server is told the share stopped as soon as it can be reached.
